title: MACP Decision Receipt
description: Portable, offline-verifiable record of one binding Commitment, defined informatively by RFC-MACP-0013 Appendix A (format macp-receipt/1). Integrity rests on commitment_hash, which is recomputed from `commitment`; authenticity rests on `attestations`, each of which declares what it binds. Key distribution and trust are out of scope.

receipt_format.description: Version of this receipt format. A verifier MUST refuse a value it does not implement.

session_id.description: The session whose Commitment this receipt records.

mode.description: Mode identifier of the session (for example macp.mode.decision.v1).

commitment.description: The RFC-MACP-0013 §3 hashing projection of the Commitment's CommitmentPayload.

commitment_wire_b64.description: Optional. Base64 of the CommitmentPayload's Protobuf wire encoding. When present, a verifier MUST run RFC-MACP-0013 §6.1 verification on it against commitment_hash and MUST check that it projects to `commitment`.

semantics_rev.description: Optional. The semantics revision the session was accepted under (RFC-MACP-0003 §3.2), scoped to the implementation that recorded it.

transcript.description: Optional. A digest of the accepted session history. The construction is implementation-defined (RFC-MACP-0013 §10), so `digest_alg` names it and a verifier that does not know it treats the field as informative.

issuer.description: Opaque identifier of the party issuing the receipt (a runtime id, URL, DID or agent identifier). Not itself a trust anchor.

issued_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC time the receipt was issued. Informational.

attestations.description: Zero or more attestations. A receipt with none is a valid integrity-only receipt.

jws_attestation.description: A detached-payload JWS (RFC 7515 Appendix F) whose payload is the JCS canonicalization of the receipt with `attestations` removed. It therefore binds commitment_hash.

jws.description: Compact JWS with an empty payload segment: <protected header>..<signature>.

vendor_attestation.description: An attestation in a format this annex does not define (for example an AITP Trust Context Token). It counts toward authenticity only when `binds` is commitment_hash or receipt and the verifier implements `format`.

format.description: Reverse-domain or otherwise collision-free name of the attestation format and version.

binds.description: What the attestation's own preimage covers: commitment_hash directly, the same JCS receipt body a JWS attestation signs, or something else (informative only).

value.description: The attestation itself, in the encoding `format` defines.
